messages:
maria (AE): Quick sync — enterprise signed MSA, they want a POC + committed reservation. Target: ~100k qps-month, peak 5k RPS. Need recommended reserved GPU config, burst policy, preheat/runbook, plus pricing + security answers.
caleb (sales_eng): Noted. They also flagged a 99th p99 token latency target of 200ms. Will push for quantized model variants in the quote.
anya (solutions): Suggest baseline: 6 reserved GPUs (A100-80 equiv) with ability to burst to 9 via credits. Split across 2 AZs. KV cache warmup expected to reduce token ops ~30% for sessioned chat.
tom (infra): Ops constraints: reserve spread = AZ1:3 / AZ2:3. Autoscale policy example: scale_up when gpu_util > 70% for 30s -> add 1 GPU; scale_down when gpu_util < 30% for 5m -> remove 1 GPU. Preheat recipe: staggered warmup 2h before ramp, run kv-warmup and synthetic traffic at 75% load.
caleb (sales_eng): Customer pricing question: committed discount + burst credits. Can we give a range for monthly cost on the 6-GPU baseline assuming mixed-precision vs 4-bit quant?
anya (solutions): Ballpark: mixed-precision baseline (non-quant) X = "$12k per GPU/month" (example) -> 6 GPUs = "$72k/mo". With 4-bit quant + batching expect ~40-50% token cost reduction -> range "$36k-$44k/mo". Burst credits billed at reduced rate, e.g., 10% premium on committed unit price. (I'll send formal calc.)
infra-bot: reservation-check: OK. region capacity available.
maria (AE): Security questionnaire item: they require KMS integration + 13mo audit log retention + SOC2 mention. Is Dedicated enough or do they need Private?
legal-liaison: Dedicated with customer-managed KMS + audit forwarding covers this. Private only if they require on-prem or hard air-gap. We should add a clause for model licensing if they bring a third-party quantized model.
tom (infra): Preheat runbook (short):
- T-120m: schedule kv-warmup job across 6 GPUs
- T-90m: run synthetic traffic at 50% load for 30m
- T-60m: run synthetic traffic at 75% load for 45m (validate latency/SLO)
- T-0: allow burst credits to enable +50% capacity for 4 hours
Smoke test command examples:
./kv-warmup --model mix-quant --sessions 1500 --concurrency 150
./loadgen --rps 3750 --ctx 2000 --duration 45m
caleb (sales_eng): They asked for contractual wording on coldstart SLA. We can't promise P99 for cold starts unless runbook is followed. Can legal draft a conditional SLO?
legal-liaison: Yes — we can craft a conditional SLO: "P99 latency SLO of 200ms when preheat runbook and KV warmup are executed by customer/Redwood within agreed windows; otherwise best-effort." Will add ops appendix referencing the exact commands.
anya (solutions): Autoscale JSON snippet for quote (plain text): {"min_reserved_gpus":"6","max_total_gpus":"9","scale_up_threshold":"0.7","scale_down_threshold":"0.3","burst_limit_hours_per_month":"120"}
maria (AE): Maria: Timeline — need final numbers for AE deck and quote by EOD local. Caleb/Anya/Tom please post final calc + runbook here.
anya (solutions): Will post calc in 25m with per-GPU cost breakout and sensitivity for model variants.
tom (infra): I'll post the preheat checklist + smoke test pass criteria. Ops note: recommend a canary ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% for first production day.
caleb (sales_eng): I'll add pricing language: committed reservation discount 30% off list on committed units; burst credits available at 10% surcharge; model-licensing passthrough if third-party. Legal to confirm.
maria (AE): Great — please ping when docs ready. leaving this thread open for the attachables. :white_check_mark:
